title: dut_console/test_console_baud_rate.py::test_baud_rate_sonic_connect uses ssh for telnet console
author: MichaelWangSmci
body:

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
The case dut_console/test_console_baud_rate.py::test_baud_rate_sonic_connect always uses ssh to connect a telnet console server.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run the test dut_console/test_console_baud_rate.py::test_baud_rate_sonic_connect on PTF32 topology

**Describe the results you received:**
```
________________________________________________________________________ ERROR at setup of test_baud_rate_sonic_connect ________________________________________________________________________

duthost = <MultiAsicSonicHost lab-inno-01>
conn_graph_facts = {'device_bmc_info': {'lab-inno-01': {}}, 'device_bmc_link': {'lab-inno-01': {}}, 'device_conn': {'lab-inno-01': {'Ethe...Hostname': u'console-1', 'HwSku': u'Comtrol', 'ManagementGw': u'10.184.3.3', 'ManagementIp': u'10.184.3.2', ...}}, ...}
creds = {'ansible_become_pass': 'password', 'ansible_ssh_pass': 'ADMIN', 'ansible_ssh_user': 'ADMIN', 'bgp_slb_passive_range': '10.255.0.0/25', ...}

    @pytest.fixture(scope="module")
    def console_client_setup_teardown(duthost, conn_graph_facts, creds):
        pytest_assert(pass_config_test, "Fail due to failure in test_console_baud_rate_config.")
        dut_hostname = duthost.hostname
        console_host = conn_graph_facts['device_console_info'][dut_hostname]['ManagementIp']
        pytest_require(is_sonic_console(conn_graph_facts, dut_hostname), "Unsupport non-sonic console swith.")
        console_port = conn_graph_facts['device_console_link'][dut_hostname]['ConsolePort']['peerport']
        dutuser = creds['sonicadmin_user']
        dutpass = creds['sonicadmin_password']

        client = None
        try:
            client = create_ssh_client(console_host, "{}:{}".format(dutuser, console_port), dutpass)
        except Exception as err:
>           pytest.fail("Not connect console ssh, error: {}".format(err))
E           Failed: Not connect console ssh, error: Timeout exceeded.
E           <pexpect.pty_spawn.spawn object at 0x7f85b066ee10>
E           command: /usr/bin/ssh
E           args: ['/usr/bin/ssh', 'admin:4019@10.184.3.2', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=no', '-o', 'UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null']
E           buffer (last 100 chars): ''
E           before (last 100 chars): ''
E           after: <class 'pexpect.exceptions.TIMEOUT'>
E           match: None
E           match_index: None
E           exitstatus: None
E           flag_eof: False
E           pid: 52889
E           child_fd: 13
E           closed: False
E           timeout: 30
E           delimiter: <class 'pexpect.exceptions.EOF'>
E           logfile: None
E           logfile_read: None
E           logfile_send: None
E           maxread: 2000
E           ignorecase: False
E           searchwindowsize: None
E           delaybeforesend: 0.05
E           delayafterclose: 0.1
E           delayafterterminate: 0.1
E           searcher: searcher_re:
E               0: re.compile('[Pp]assword:')

client     = None
conn_graph_facts = {'device_bmc_info': {'lab-inno-01': {}}, 'device_bmc_link': {'lab-inno-01': {}}, 'device_conn': {'lab-inno-01': {'Ethe...Hostname': u'console-1', 'HwSku': u'Comtrol', 'ManagementGw': u'10.184.3.3', 'ManagementIp': u'10.184.3.2', ...}}, ...}
console_host = u'10.184.3.2'
console_port = u'4019'
creds      = {'ansible_become_pass': 'password', 'ansible_ssh_pass': 'ADMIN', 'ansible_ssh_user': 'ADMIN', 'bgp_slb_passive_range': '10.255.0.0/25', ...}
dut_hostname = 'lab-inno-01'
duthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost lab-inno-01>
dutpass    = 'YourPaSsWoRd'
dutuser    = 'admin'
err        = TIMEOUT("Timeout exceeded.\n<pexpect.pty_spawn.spawn object at 0x7f85b066ee10>...terterminate: 0.1\nsearcher: searcher_re:\n    0: re.compile('[Pp]assword:')",)

dut_console/test_console_baud_rate.py:55: Failed
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
I set the console type to telnet in sonic_lab_console_links.csv,
so I expect it to use telnet to connect to the console server.

**Additional information you deem important:**
<!--
software/ASIC/Hardware Flatform version and info
-->
```
$ cat ansible/files/sonic_lab_console_links.csv
StartDevice,StartPort,EndDevice,Console_type,Proxy,BaudRate
console-1,4019,lab-inno-01,telnet,root,115200
```
